---
title: "Alpine Ski Data Scraping Description"
format: html
---

Loading necessary packages
```{r}
# There was an update to the website. The original race id no longer works. 
# The W_Tremblant_GS.csv is from the FIS Alpine Skiing World Cup Women's GS on December 2, 2023.
# The race id is 118343
# URL https://www.fis-ski.com/DB/general/results.html?sectorcode=AL&raceid=118343
library(rvest)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
```

We need a function to convert times to seconds. 
```{r}
fix_time <- function(time_str){
  sapply(time_str, function(t) {
    t <- trimws(t)
    if(is.na(t) || t == "" || t == "NA") return(NA_real_)
    ms(t) |> period_to_seconds()
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}
```

Here is the main function to scrape the data and reformat it.
```{r}
get_ski <- function(race_id){
  
  # Input url
  url <- paste0("https://www.fis-ski.com/DB/general/results.html?sectorcode=AL&raceid=", race_id) 
  
  # Read the HTML page
  elements <- read_html(url)
  
  result_table <- html_elements(elements, "div.table")[[8]]
  sections <- html_elements(result_table, "div.table__body")
  finished_rows <- html_elements(sections[[1]], "a.table-row")
  dnf_r2_rows <- html_elements(sections[[2]], "a.table-row")
  all_rows <- c(finished_rows, dnf_r2_rows)

  extract_row <- function(row) {
    parts <- str_split(html_text2(row), "\n")[[1]] |> trimws()
    parts <- parts[parts != ""]
    n <- length(parts)
    if(n >= 12) {
      tibble(Rank = parts[1], Bib = parts[2], Name = parts[4],
             Nat = parts[6], Run1_str = parts[7], Run2_str = parts[8],
             Total_str = parts[9])
    } else {
      tibble(Rank = NA_character_, Bib = parts[1], Name = parts[3],
             Nat = parts[5], Run1_str = parts[6], Run2_str = NA_character_,
             Total_str = NA_character_)
    }
  }

  # constructing a data frame
  results_df <- bind_rows(lapply(all_rows, extract_row))

  # tidying the data and using the fix_time() function
  results_df <- results_df |>
    mutate(
      Run1_Order = as.integer(Bib),
      Run1_Time  = fix_time(Run1_str),
      Run2_Time  = fix_time(Run2_str),
      Total_Time = fix_time(Total_str),
      Final_Rank = as.integer(Rank)
    )

  ## Calculate Run1_Rank and Run2_Rank from times
  results_df <- results_df |>
    mutate(
      Run1_Rank = as.integer(rank(Run1_Time, na.last = "keep")),
      Run2_Rank = as.integer(rank(Run2_Time, na.last = "keep"))
    )

  n_run2 <- nrow(results_df)
  results_df <- results_df |>
    mutate(
      Run1_Rank_unique = rank(Run1_Time, na.last = "keep", ties.method = "first"),
      Run2_Order = as.integer(n_run2 - Run1_Rank_unique + 1),
      Rank_Diff = ifelse(is.na(Final_Rank), NA_real_, Run1_Rank - Final_Rank)
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(!is.na(Final_Rank)), Final_Rank, Run2_Order) |>
    select(Name, Nat, Run1_Order, Run1_Time, Run1_Rank,
           Run2_Order, Run2_Time, Run2_Rank, Total_Time, Final_Rank, Rank_Diff)
  return(results_df)
}
```

Testing out the scraping function with race id. The race id comes from the raceid parameter in the URL. For example, https://www.fis-ski.com/DB/general/results.html?sectorcode=AL&raceid=118343 has race id 118343.
```{r}
x = get_ski(118343)
```

Saving as csv
```{r}
write.csv(x, "W_Tremblant_GS_new.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
